summary: Suppress near-duplicate alerts on POST /api/alerts: when an active alert with the same Title (case-insensitive) and Severity was created within a configurable window (default 15 min), return 200 OK with the existing alert and header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true instead of creating a new row; a genuinely new alert still returns 201 Created.
scope_anchors: IAlertRepository / AlertRepository (find active duplicate in window)
constraints: Duplicate match = active alert (IsActive == true) AND same Severity AND Title equal case-insensitively AND CreatedDate >= (now - window). All four must hold; do not match on Title substring.
Must NOT suppress across different severities, and must NOT suppress when the prior matching alert is inactive.

On suppression: return 200 OK with the existing alert body and response header 'X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true'. On genuine create: return 201 Created (existing CreatedAtRoute behavior); do not set the header (or set it to false) on a real create.
Suppression window in minutes MUST be read from appsettings.json (bound options), never hardcoded; provide a sensible default (15) when the setting is absent.
DECISION: Config section 'Alerts:DuplicateSuppression:WindowMinutes' bound to a DuplicateSuppressionOptions class registered in Program.cs; default WindowMinutes = 15.

DECISION: IAlertService.CreateAsync returns a suppression-aware result (e.g. CreateAlertResult(bool Suppressed, AlertResponse Alert)) so the controller chooses status code + header; keep DTOs entity-free.
DECISION: Use TimeProvider (already injected) to compute the window threshold for deterministic, testable time.
DECISION: Duplicate lookup lives in the repository (new IAlertRepository method); keep EF/LINQ out of the controller and service business logic per service-architecture standards.
Repository duplicate query: no SELECT *; filter server-side on IsActive, Severity, case-insensitive Title equality, and CreatedDate threshold; if multiple match, prefer the most recent.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage on suppression (200 + header, no new row), genuine create (201), no-suppress-across-severity, no-suppress-when-inactive, and outside-window create.
>=90% line coverage on changed service/repository/controller code per coding-standards.
